verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation SDK with server-side components, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path (all returned 404). The llms.txt file is LLM-oriented documentation, not an API specification, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
